items.title: ElevenLabs study: voice agents beat chat on long, complex conversations; latency drives success
items.summary: ElevenLabs compared voice and chat across deployed agents (May–July 2026). In conversations over two minutes voice succeeded ~32% more often, while chat won under one minute. Across 315 agents that switched to a faster LLM, a 16% drop in end-to-end latency came with a 26% lift in success rate. The data is self-reported by a voice vendor.
items.whyItMatters: It backs latency work on Romain/Anna with numbers (faster LLM turn = better outcomes) and suggests voice suits longer, more demanding practice sessions rather than quick drills.

items.title: Anthropic's amended S-1 says it may imminently hit its RSI threshold
items.summary: A revised filing says Anthropic may soon meet its Responsible Scaling Policy threshold for dramatically accelerated AI-attributable progress. No current model is designated as over it, and the company is considering RSP updates to keep humans in the loop. Skeptics note an S-1 is also marketing.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing as a signal of how fast frontier model capability, and therefore the models behind tutoring tools, may be moving.
